summary: Hesai Group reported Q1 2026 earnings on May 19. Revenue RMB680.6M (+29.6% YoY), GAAP net income RMB18.3M (turnaround from RMB-17.5M net loss). 471,723 lidar units shipped (+140.9% YoY): 353,441 ADAS (+141.9%) and 118,282 robotics (+137.8%). Mercedes-Benz L3 supplier win confirmed. Q2 guidance RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY). Pre-market shares +9%.
